reference.time_convention: t = n/24 s, n 0-based; verified 241 frames decoded (OpenCV), ffprobe count 241, GOP: 8 I / 64 P / 169 B

units: pixels in the contract pixel convention; angles in degrees (image-plane only) unless *_rad

camera_drift.verdict: GENUINE FRAMING DRIFT (camera move): smooth, monotonic zoom-in/dolly-in over the whole clip; not a static camera
camera_drift.model: per-frame 8-dof homography frame0->frame n, ECC on static mask, init chained KLT; camera_drift.csv

pivot.definition: wire departure point at the bottom of the wire loop on the steel pin (tracked landmark wire_departure)

bob.method: A radial luma edge + robust geometric circle fit (free radius); B annulus multi-scale ZNCC; per-frame sigma = sqrt(fit_cov + local-RMS(A-B)^2/2)
bob.radius_note: apparent radius grows ~5% from the left to the right turning point (both methods: A circle radius, B best template scale); consistent with the swing having a depth component toward the camera on the image-right side (inference) - the camera specialist should use it

angle_image.definition: atan2(u_bob-u_pivot, v_bob-v_pivot) in the same raw frame; NOT a world angle

damped_sine_fit_angle.model: theta = c0 + c1 t + A exp(-g t) cos(w t + phi), weighted by sigma, all 241 frames

suspension.verdict: CURVED in the image whenever the bob is away from centre: quadratic sagitta from -4.9 to +4.7 px over ~650 px of wire (formal sd ~0.03 px), correlated with the swing angle (r=0.94, 0.53 px/deg); near zero crossings within ~1-2 px of straight. Control: static stand edges of similar length measured the same way are straight to <=0.45 px, so lens distortion does not explain it. A straight 3D wire projects to a straight image line (pinhole), so the bowing is an image-content property of the AI clip.

cadence_defect.finding: 4-frame generator cadence: the bob step into every frame n = 4k is ~1.58x the local velocity, the other three steps ~0.80-0.84x. Present in every GOP although the H.264 P-frame grid shifts (P at n mod 4 = 0,2,3,1 in different GOPs), so it is generator-native, not encoder.
cadence_defect.note: diagnostic only; must not be used to retime the simulation (contract). Expect R2/R3 residual floors of a few px at peak speed from this alone.

verdicts.camera: NOT static. Smooth monotonic zoom-in/dolly-in: similarity scale 1.0000 -> 1.0327 nearly linear in t, rotation < 0.05 deg, pivot moves (+4.1,-0.8) px, base corners ~25-30 px. A per-frame homography explains all static landmarks to 0.77 px RMS (residual grows to ~1-1.5 px late in the clip: small parallax / non-planarity). camera_drift.csv.
verdicts.pivot: Fixed relative to the stand: wire departure point residual after drift 0.67 px RMS; swing-correlated motion <=0.5 px peak-to-peak; the loop on the pin does not visibly rock.
verdicts.wire: CURVED in the image whenever the bob is away from centre: quadratic sagitta from -4.9 to +4.7 px over ~650 px of wire (formal sd ~0.03 px), correlated with the swing angle (r=0.94, 0.53 px/deg); near zero crossings within ~1-2 px of straight. Control: static stand edges of similar length measured the same way are straight to <=0.45 px, so lens distortion does not explain it. A straight 3D wire projects to a straight image line (pinhole), so the bowing is an image-content property of the AI clip.
verdicts.amplitude: NOT monotonic decay. Half peak-to-peak image angle 5.77 deg (t=0.86 s) -> 5.45 (t=3.64) -> GROWS to 8.84 (t=7.13) -> 6.48 (t=9.26); per-point sd 0.02-0.04 deg. Net growth over the clip; non-physical for a passive pendulum (reference defect). Camera drift (similarity, rot<0.05 deg) cannot create this because the image angle is similarity-invariant; stabilized-u amplitude shows the same pattern.
verdicts.period: Image-space period 1.404 +- 0.003 s (zero crossings), 1.4007 +- 0.0012 s (damped-sine fit, formal; model inadequate, reduced chi2 291). Cycle-to-cycle 1.357-1.434 s (sd 0.026 s, >> timing sd 0.002 s): period itself is not constant. Eyeball 1.25 s was wrong.
verdicts.phase_t0: Not at a turning point at t=0: bob is at about -3.3 deg (image angle minus offset, ~57% of amplitude) on the image-left side moving right at ~20 deg/s; first turning point (right) at t=0.522 s; the preceding left turning point extrapolates to t~-0.20 s. Not released from rest at t=0.
verdicts.bob_shape: Silhouette is near-circular: ellipse minor/major 0.94-0.995 (median ~0.977, not correlated with speed, r=-0.02, so not motion blur; cause not determined). Apparent radius varies smoothly 55.3-60.2 px, ~5% larger at the image-right extreme (both methods); max frame-to-frame change of drift-normalized radius 1.71 px, of drift-normalized pivot-to-bob distance 2.95 px (largest at fast frames, cadence).

frame_quality.codec: H.264 yuv420p, 5.96 Mbit/s, GOPs of ~30 frames with I/P/B (8 I, 64 P, 169 B)
frame_quality.chroma: 4:2:0 plus compression makes chroma blocky at 8-16 px; all geometry uses full-resolution luma only
frame_quality.motion_blur: visible horizontal blur on the bob's left/right rim near mid-swing (e.g. frames 20-21, 36); top/bottom rims stay sharp; a circle-fit centre is unbiased for symmetric blur; fitted ellipse ratio shows no measurable speed dependence
frame_quality.wire: twisted two-strand look, ~5 px wide, dark on light wall; centroid of the dark band is used (darkest pixel alternates between strands)
frame_quality.highlight: specular highlight and reflections move inside the bob and are excluded (edge-only fit A; annulus-only template B)
